result.description: Web data API for AI agents: search, scrape, crawl, map, and extract clean Markdown or structured data from the live web.
result.auth_detail: Per-user API key (fc-...) sent as Authorization: Bearer. Also an OAuth 2.1 server (PKCE S256, dynamic client registration) so apps can connect users' accounts; client_id needs no Firecrawl approval.
result.access_detail: Gate audit (1): no app review, listing, or partner status. OAuth docs say a client_id needs no Firecrawl approval, and users can also create their own API key at /app/api-keys. (2): the free plan is $0 with no card and gives 1,000 credits/month (low rate limits, 2 concurrent). The docs say free signup gives direct API access. Pay-as-you-go and higher limits need paid plans, but API access does not.
result.api_notes: REST at api.firecrawl.dev. Endpoints: scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, plus agent, interact/browser sandbox, parse, and webhooks. Focused scraping surface (about 10-20 endpoints), not a broad CRUD product.

evidence.quote: Firecrawl is the context API for AI agents.
The header should contain `Bearer fc-123456789`, where `fc-123456789` represents your API Key.
Firecrawl runs an OAuth 2.1 authorization server.
Your app needs a `client_id`. There are two ways to get one, and neither needs approval from Firecrawl.
Firecrawl gives you 1,000 free credits every month, which covers about 1,000 pages, and no card is required.
Create a free account for direct API access and higher limits
Search, scrape, and interact with the live web to get clean Markdown or structured data.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that brings Firecrawl, the context API for AI agents, to MCP-compatible clients
Set up Firecrawl MCP with keyless access, account sign-in, or an API key.
